shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && ls -la && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/ && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

sed -n 1,120p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo ---- && grep -n -i -C 6 'chart\|yagr\|timeseries\|time series' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,200p && echo ---- && cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore && echo ---- && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -80
cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -250
sed -n 250,400p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md
npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20
npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -15; for v in 6 7 8; do echo "== chartkit@$v"; npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit@$v version peerDependencies 2>/dev/null | tail -8; done

npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit@8.12.0 dependencies peerDependenciesMeta optionalDependencies 2>/dev/null; echo ==; npm view @gravity-ui/charts peerDependencies version 2>/dev/null; echo ==; npm view @gravity-ui/yagr peerDependencies version 2>/dev/null

npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1 peerDependencies version 2>/dev/null | tail -8 && npm install @gravity-ui/chartkit@^8.12.0 2>&1 | tail -5 && node -e "for (const p of ['chartkit','charts','yagr','uikit']) console.log(p, require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/'+p+'/package.json').version)" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build 2>/dev/null | head -40

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; find node_modules -maxdepth 4 -path '*@gravity-ui/charts/package.json' -o -maxdepth 4 -path '*@gravity-ui/yagr/package.json' | head; grep -n '"@gravity-ui/\(charts\|yagr\)"' package-lock.json | head

npm install @gravity-ui/charts@^1.73.0 @gravity-ui/yagr@^5 2>&1 | grep -v allow-scripts | tail -3; node -e "for (const p of ['chartkit','charts','yagr','uikit']) console.log(p, require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/'+p+'/package.json').version)"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; echo "== docs"; for p in chartkit charts yagr; do echo "-- $p"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; done

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs/INDEX.md; echo "==== guides"; ls -R node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs/guides; echo "==== README"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/README.md

CK=node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit; cat $CK/package.json | sed -n '/"exports"/,/^  }/p'; echo "=== index.d.ts"; cat $CK/build/index.d.ts; echo "=== types"; ls $CK/build/types; cat $CK/build/types/widget.d.ts $CK/build/types/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -150; echo "=== plugins"; ls $CK/build/plugins $CK/build/plugins/yagr $CK/build/plugins/gravity-charts; echo "=== yagr index"; cat $CK/build/plugins/yagr/index.d.ts; echo "=== yagr types"; cat $CK/build/plugins/yagr/types/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120; echo "=== gravity-charts index"; cat $CK/build/plugins/gravity-charts/index.d.ts; cat $CK/build/plugins/gravity-charts/types/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80

CK=node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit; echo "=== yagr plugin types"; cat $CK/build/plugins/yagr/types.d.ts; echo; echo "=== gravity-charts plugin types"; cat $CK/build/plugins/gravity-charts/types.d.ts; echo; echo "=== charts docs INDEX"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md | head -120; echo; echo "=== yagr README (data/config)"; grep -n -i -C 3 'timeline\|series\|scales\|axes\|cursor\|tooltip\|chart:\|appearance\|theme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md | head -200

C=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs; echo "=== line.md"; sed -n 1,140p $C/guides/series-types/line.md; echo "=== axis-types.md"; grep -n -C 4 'datetime' $C/guides/axes/axis-types.md | head -80; echo "=== axes index (xAxis fields)"; sed -n 1,120p $C/guides/axes/index.md

Y=node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr; ls $Y/dist $Y/dist/types 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "=== types/index"; f=$(find $Y/dist -name 'index.d.ts' -path '*types*' | head -3); echo $f; for x in $f; do sed -n 1,400p $x; done | grep -v '^\s*$' | head -400

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit SegmentedRadioGroup RadioButton Card Text Flex Loader Skeleton Label 2>&1 | head -80; echo "=== chartkit yagr renderer theme handling"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer; grep -n -i 'theme\|useThemeType\|appearance' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/*.js | head -20
Y=node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr; grep -v '^\s*$' $Y/dist/types.d.ts | sed -n 1,420p
sed -n 90,170p node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/utils.js

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit SegmentedRadioGroup RadioButton Card Text Flex Loader Skeleton Label 2>&1 | head -60; echo "=== SegmentedRadioGroup props"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo "=== Card props"; grep -n 'view\|type\|theme\|size' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -20

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist; ls $D; f=$(grep -rl 'export type ChartData\b\|export interface ChartData\b\|type ChartData =' $D --include=*.d.ts | head -3); echo "$f"; for x in $f; do grep -n -A 40 'ChartData\b.*[={]' $x | head -80; done; echo "=== ChartXAxis"; x=$(grep -rl 'ChartXAxis' $D --include=*.d.ts | head -1); echo $x; grep -n -A 60 'export type ChartXAxis\|export interface ChartXAxis' $x | head -120; echo "=== tooltip/legend/title types"; grep -rn -A 12 'export type ChartTooltip\b\|export interface ChartTooltip\b\|export type ChartLegend\b\|export interface ChartLegend\b\|export type ChartTitle\b\|export interface ChartTitle\b\|export interface ChartOptions\b\|export type ChartOptions\b' $D --include=*.d.ts | head -120
D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types; sed -n 81,140p $D/index.d.ts; echo "=== axis d.ts"; ls $D/chart; grep -v '^\s*$' $D/chart/axis.d.ts | grep -v '^\s*\*\|^\s*/\*\*' | head -150
Y=node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore; ls $Y; grep -v '^\s*$' $Y/types.d.ts | grep -v '^\s*\*\|^\s*/\*\*' | sed -n 1,330p

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; echo "=== ControlGroupOption"; grep -n -A 12 'ControlGroupOption<' $U/types.d.ts | head -40; echo "=== Skeleton"; cat $U/Skeleton/Skeleton.d.ts | head -30; echo "=== Loader"; cat $U/Loader/Loader.d.ts | head -20; echo "=== Label"; grep -n 'theme\|size\|value' $U/Label/Label.d.ts | head -12; echo "=== Text variants"; grep -n 'TEXT_VARIANTS\|header-\|body-\|caption-' $U/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -20; echo "=== Flex"; grep -n 'direction\|gap\|justifyContent\|alignItems\|wrap' $U/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -12

Y=node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore; echo "=== cursor"; grep -v '^\s*$' $Y/plugins/cursor/cursor.d.ts | grep -v '^\s*\*\|^\s*/\*\*' | head -50; echo "=== legend"; grep -v '^\s*$' $Y/plugins/legend/legend.d.ts | grep -v '^\s*\*\|^\s*/\*\*' | head -40; echo "=== tooltip types"; grep -v '^\s*$' $Y/plugins/tooltip/types.d.ts | grep -v '^\s*\*\|^\s*/\*\*' | head -90

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types; echo "=== line.d.ts"; grep -v '^\s*$' $D/chart/line.d.ts | grep -v '^\s*\*\|^\s*/\*\*' | head -80; echo "=== base series fields"; grep -n -B2 -A3 '^\s*id?\|^\s*name\|^\s*color?\|^\s*visible?' $D/chart/base.d.ts | head -40; echo "=== FormatNumberOptions"; grep -v '^\s*$' $D/formatter.d.ts | grep -v '^\s*\*\|^\s*/\*\*' | head -40; echo "=== exported names"; grep -n 'LineSeries\b\|LineSeriesData\b\|ChartData\b' $D/index.d.ts $D/chart/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn 'export \* from\|export type {' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/index.d.ts | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm; echo "=== BaseSeries"; sed -n 78,106p $D/core/types/chart/base.d.ts | grep -v '^\s*\*\|^\s*/\*\*'; echo "=== FormatNumberOptions"; grep -v '^\s*$' $D/libs/format-number/types.d.ts | grep -v '^\s*\*\|^\s*/\*\*' | head -60; echo "=== PointMarkerOptions"; grep -v '^\s*$' $D/core/types/chart/marker.d.ts | grep -v '^\s*\*\|^\s*/\*\*' | head -30; echo "=== root type exports"; cat $D/core/types/index.d.ts | sed -n 1,40p; cat $D/types/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; grep -rn 'LineSeries' $D/core/types/chart/series.d.ts | head -5
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E 'error|Widget|index-|built in' ; echo "build exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; git status --short | grep -v node_modules
rm -rf dist && printf 'dist/\n' >> .gitignore && cat .gitignore && git diff --stat package.json && grep -n gravity package.json
